decisions.reason: הַבְּרִיאָה is the article with בְּרִיאָה, creation (H1278). H1277 בָּרִיא means fat or healthy and does not fit the verse.

evidence.lexicon: H1278 בְּרִיאָה: a creation, thing created. H1277 בָּרִיא: fat; healthy, sound.
evidence.grammar: Patah under ה with dagesh in the following בּ is the article. The rest of the word, בְּרִיאָה, has the consonants and vowels of the H1278 lemma, including the final ה.
evidence.context: מֵרֵאשִׁית הַבְּרִיאָה אֲשֶׁר בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים, from the beginning of the creation which God created. The relative clause uses the verb בָּרָא from the same root.

decisions.reason: כַכַּלָּה is the preposition כְּ with the article before כַּלָּה, bride (H3618). H5369 נֵר (lamp, Nêr) shares no letters with the stem.

evidence.lexicon: H3618 כַּלָּה: daughter-in-law, bride. H5369 נֵר (Nêr): lamp.
evidence.grammar: Patah under the first כ with dagesh in the second כּ is כְּ with the article absorbed. The stem כַּלָּה is the H3618 lemma, and the tagged Hk prefix stays.
evidence.context: נְכוֹנָה כַכַּלָּה הַמְקֻשֶּׁטֶת לְבַעְלָהּ, prepared as the bride adorned for her husband.
